start.title: On the Edge of Promise
start.text:
The wilderness ends here at Paran.
The Lord says, "Send out scouts."

choices.text: March in blindly without a scout
Choose one leader from each tribe

rash_consequence.title: Listen Before You March
rash_consequence.text:
He spoke a way; do not run past it.
Gather the chosen scouts.

choices.text: Choose one leader from each tribe

spies_depart.title: Twelve into the Hills
spies_depart.text:
Joshua and Caleb stand among them.
Forty days they will search the land.

choices.text: Send them with prayer and a charge
Threaten them if they bring bad news
Promise them spoil for false praise

threat_consequence.title: Send Them in Faith
threat_consequence.text:
A scout under threat will only lie.
Bless them and trust the Lord.

choices.text: Send them with prayer and a charge

bribe_consequence.title: Truth Cannot Be Bought
bribe_consequence.text:
His promise needs no flattery.
Let them see and speak plainly.

choices.text: Send them with prayer and a charge
choices.feedback: You lift hands over the twelve.

valley_seen.title: Valley of Eshcol
valley_seen.text:
Vines bend with grapes large as stones.
The land is rich beyond words.

choices.text: Mistrust the gift and turn back
Cut a cluster as a sign for Israel
choices.feedback: Two men carry it on a pole.

mistrust_consequence.title: Receive His Gift
mistrust_consequence.text:
What He gives, He gives in full.
Take the sign back to the camp.

choices.text: Cut a cluster as a sign for Israel

city_seen.title: The Walled City
city_seen.text:
Tall walls rise above the plain.
Giants walk along their stones.

choices.text: Forget the city and report fruit alone
Remember the Lord goes before you
Decide the land cannot be taken

hide_consequence.title: Tell the Whole Truth
hide_consequence.text:
Israel must hear what is real.
Fruit and walls, both belong to Him.

choices.text: Remember the Lord goes before you

fear_consequence.title: Look Beyond the Walls
fear_consequence.text:
He who parted the sea is here.
Walls are nothing in His hand.

choices.text: Remember the Lord goes before you

report_back.title: Around the Council Fire
report_back.text:
Ten spies cry, "We are like grasshoppers."
The camp begins to tremble.

choices.text: Agree with the fearful ten
choices.feedback: Faith does not bow to fear.

choices.text: Stay silent and let panic spread
Let Joshua and Caleb answer

agree_consequence.title: Stand on His Word
agree_consequence.text:
Numbers are not greater than God.
Let faithful voices be heard.

choices.text: Let Joshua and Caleb answer

silent_consequence.title: Silence Lets Fear Win
silent_consequence.text:
Truth must be spoken aloud.
Give the floor to the faithful.

choices.text: Let Joshua and Caleb answer

caleb_speaks.title: "We Can Surely Take It"
caleb_speaks.text:
Caleb pleads, Joshua at his side.
"The Lord is with us. Do not fear."

choices.text: Silence them to keep peace
Stand with their faith before all
choices.feedback: You raise your staff in agreement.

silence_consequence.title: Faith Must Be Honored
silence_consequence.text:
Their words are the Lord's voice tonight.
Stand beside them openly.

choices.text: Stand with their faith before all
choices.feedback: The camp turns to look at you.

people_weep.title: A Night of Weeping
people_weep.text:
The camp wails through the dark.
"Better to die in Egypt!" they cry.

choices.text: Mock the people in their sorrow
Fall on your face and pray for them
Pack your tent and leave alone
choices.feedback: A shepherd does not flee his sheep.

mock_consequence.title: Carry Their Grief
mock_consequence.text:
Scorn cannot heal a frightened camp.
Intercede on your knees.

choices.text: Fall on your face and pray for them

leave_consequence.title: Stay with Your People
leave_consequence.text:
The Lord set you over them.
Do not abandon what He gave.

choices.text: Fall on your face and pray for them
choices.feedback: You turn back to your knees.

rebellion.title: "Stone Them!" the Crowd Shouts
rebellion.text:
Hands lift against Joshua and Caleb.
The glory of the Lord appears.

choices.text: Let the Lord destroy them all
Plead for mercy on the people
Ask Him to make a new nation of you

destroy_consequence.title: Stand in the Breach
destroy_consequence.text:
A shepherd does not call down ruin.
Lift your voice for them.

choices.text: Plead for mercy on the people

self_consequence.title: Not for Your Name Alone
self_consequence.text:
Pray for the flock, not the shepherd.
Mercy is wider than you.

choices.text: Plead for mercy on the people
choices.feedback: His anger relents at your words.

ending.title: The Wilderness Path
ending.text:
He pardons, but the way grows long.
Faith will yet inherit the land.
